result.rationale: The diff shows newGuests comes from the AddGuestsDialog's MultiEmail input (a handful of user-typed emails) and attendees are the booking's participant list — both tiny, user-bounded arrays. The `newGuests.includes(attendee.email)` inside the attendees map is O(n*m) only in a theoretical sense with no realistic scale to cause 'delayed mail dispatch'. This is a non-actionable micro-performance nit with no material consequence; there is no unbounded array in this diff (the schema caps input to user-provided emails via `z.array(z.string().email())`).
